muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿ونزع يده فإذا هي بيضاء للناظرين﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it; نزع is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿يده﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is an adverb or a particle; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and بيضاء is the khabar (predicate); and ﴿للناظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿قال للملأ حوله إن هذا لساحر عليم﴾: قال is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; قال here has no wāw, and its agent is a latent pronoun referring to Pharaoh]; ﴿للملأ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; حوله is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿هذا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ساحر is the khabar (predicate) and عليم a second khabar; and the clause ﴿إن هذا لساحر...﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يريد أن يخرجكم من أرضكم بسحره﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ساحر﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of يريد; ﴿من أرضكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجكم﴾; and ﴿بسحره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يخرجكم﴾.
﴿فماذا تأمرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ماذا﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the second object of تأمرون, with the preposition dropped, and the first object is omitted, the implied form being: "with what thing do you command me (بأي شيء تأمرونني)?"; the clause ﴿تأمرون﴾ is conjoined to the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). Or: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun and a mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), the clause ﴿تأمرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative with no grammatical position, and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being: "so what is it that you command me (فما الذي تأمروننيه)?"; and the clause ﴿ماذا تأمرون﴾ is conjoined to the object of the speech.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿قالوا أرجه وأخاه وابعث في المدائن حاشرين﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أرجه is an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أخاه is conjoined to the hāʾ, or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); ابعث is conjoined to أرجه; ﴿في المدائن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ابعث﴾; and حاشرين is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "soldiers who will gather the sorcerers and assemble them".

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿يأتوك بكل سحار عليم﴾: يأتوك is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بكل سحار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتوك﴾; and عليم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سحار﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿فجمع السحرة لميقات يوم معلوم﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something implied; جمع is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); السحرة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿لميقات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جمع﴾; يوم is muḍāf ilayhi; and معلوم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وقيل للناس هل أنتم مجتمعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿قيل﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قيل﴾; ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مجتمعون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿لعلنا نتبع السحرة إن كانوا هم الغالبين﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); لعل is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿نتبع﴾ is its khabar (predicate); السحرة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إن is conditional; ﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw of the plural is its noun; ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); and الغالبين is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿فلما جاء السحرة قالوا لفرعون أئن لنا لأجرا إن كنا نحن الغالبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a temporal adverb (ḥīniyya, "when") or linking (rābiṭa); جاء السحرة is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ﴿لفرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالوا﴾; the hamza is interrogative; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and أجرًا is its postponed noun; إن is conditional; ﴿كنا﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿نحن﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الغالبين is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿قال نعم وإنكم إذا لمن المقربين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿نعم﴾ is a particle of answer, i.e. "you shall have the wage"; وإنكم is conjoined; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the kāf is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of answer and requital (jazāʾ); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من المقربين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿قال لهم موسى ألقوا ما أنتم ملقون﴾: قال لهم موسى is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause ألقوا is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنتم ملقون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ملقون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿فألقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزة فرعون إنا لنحن الغالبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); حبالهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿عصيهم﴾ is conjoined to حبالهم; ﴿قالوا﴾ is conjoined to فألقوا; ﴿بعزة﴾: the bāʾ is a particle of oath and a preposition, and عزة is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "نقسم"; ﴿إنا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); نحن is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and الغالبون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; or ﴿نحن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), الغالبون is the khabar of ﴿نحن﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فألقى موسى عصاه فإذا هي تلقف ما يأفكون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقى موسى عصاه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause تلقف is the khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause يأفكون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿فألقي السحرة ساجدين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقي is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); السحرة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ساجدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿قالوا آمنا برب العالمين﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنا, made of the verb and the fāʿil, is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿برب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾; and the clause of saying is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿ألقي﴾, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) with قد implied.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿رب موسى وهارون﴾: رب is a badal (substitute) from رب العالمين, or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); موسى is muḍāf ilayhi, and هارون is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿قال آمنتم له قبل أن آذن لكم﴾: قال is a past verb; the clause آمنتم is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنتم﴾; the adverb is attached to ﴿آمنتم﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آذن﴾.
﴿إنه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلسوف تعلمون﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); كبيركم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذي is a naʿt (adjective); the clause علمكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and السحر the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فلسوف﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and سوف is a particle of futurity; تعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the object is omitted.
﴿لأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلاف ولأصلبنكم أجمعين﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath. أقطعن: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". أيديكم: a mafʿūl bihi. أرجلكم: conjoined to أيديكم. ﴿من خلاف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). لأصلبنكم: conjoined to لأقطعن. أجمعين: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قالوا لا ضير إنا إلى ربنا منقلبون﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); لا is the lā of generic negation; ﴿ضير﴾ is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "no harm upon us"; the clause ﴿إنا﴾ gives the reason; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿إلى ربنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منقلبون﴾; and منقلبون is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿إنا نطمع أن يغفر لنا ربنا خطايانا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause نطمع is its khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in the forgiving of our sins" — or, on the view that ﴿نطمع﴾ is made to carry the sense of "we hope", ﴿أن﴾ together with what falls in its scope is in the position of the accusative as an object; ﴿ربنا﴾ is the fāʿil of يغفر, and خطايانا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أن كنا أول المؤمنين﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن كنا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "because we were"; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and أول المؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وأوحينا إلى موسى أن أسر بعبادي إنكم متبعون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أوحينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إلى موسى: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿أسر﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and has no grammatical position. أسر: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent. بعبادي: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أسر﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by My servants". ﴿إنكم متبعون﴾: إن, its noun and its khabar (predicate). The clause of ﴿إن﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) and resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿فأرسل فرعون في المدائن حاشرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أرسل فرعون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في المدائن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and حاشرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إن هؤلاء لشرذمة قليلون﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, which is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying"; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and هؤلاء is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); شرذمة is its khabar (predicate), and قليلون is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وإنهم لنا لغائظون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غائظون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and غائظون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿وإنا لجميع حاذرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); جميع is the first khabar (predicate) and حاذرون the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿فأخرجناهم من جنات وعيون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿أخرجناهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿من جنات وعيون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرجناهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وكنوز ومقام كريم﴾: ﴿وكنوز ومقام﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جنات وعيون﴾, and كريم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿كذلك وأورثناها بني إسرائيل﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We expelled them with an expulsion like that"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām indicates distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أورثناها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or parenthetical; أورثناها: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بني: the second mafʿūl bihi; إسرائيل: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿أورثناها...﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أخرجناهم﴾, or parenthetical with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فأتبعوهم مشرقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أتبعوهم is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Translator's note: so in the source, «second object»]; and مشرقين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فلما تراءى الجمعان قال أصحاب موسى إنا لمدركون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a temporal adverb (ḥīniyya, "when") or linking (rābiṭa); تراءى الجمعان is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of ﴿لما﴾; أصحاب is the fāʿil of قال; and the clause إنا لمدركون is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿قال كلا إن معي ربي سيهدين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿كلا﴾ is a particle of deterrence and rebuke; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and ربي is its postponed noun; ﴿إن معي﴾ gives the reason for this deterrence; and the clause سيهدين is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿فأوحينا إلى موسى أن اضرب بعصاك البحر فانفلق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أوحينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى موسى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿اضرب﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and has no grammatical position. ﴿اضرب بعصاك البحر﴾: an imperative verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بعصاك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اضرب﴾. ﴿فانفلق﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "so he struck, and it split".
﴿فكان كل فرق كالطود العظيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, كل is its noun, and ﴿فرق﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿كالطود﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان, and ﴿الطود﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿العظيم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of الطود.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿وأزلفنا ثم الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أزلفنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ثم is an adverb in the sense of "there" (هناك); and الآخرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿وأنجينا موسى ومن معه أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنجينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is conjoined to what precedes; موسى is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مَن is conjoined to موسى; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿ثم أغرقنا الآخرين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; أغرقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and الآخرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the noun of إن, accusative (manṣūb); the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and العزيز الرحيم are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز الرحيم are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿واتل عليهم نبأ إبراهيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتل is conjoined to the implied اذكر in His words ﴿وإذ نادى ربك موسى﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اتل﴾; and نبأ إبراهيم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ما تعبدون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبأ﴾, or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of the accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿نبأ﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لأبيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; قومه is conjoined; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) fronted before ﴿تعبدون﴾; and the clause ما تعبدون is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قالوا نعبد أصناما فنظل لها عاكفين﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause نعبد أصنامًا is in the position of the accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿فنظل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and نظل is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاكفين﴾; and عاكفين is the khabar (predicate) of نظل.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿قال هل يسمعونكم إذ تدعون﴾: قال is a past verb; هل is an interrogative particle; يسمعونكم is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the assumption of something omitted, i.e. "do they hear your supplication", or "do they hear you as you call"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسمعونكم﴾; تدعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause تدعون is genitive through the adverb being annexed to it.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿أو ينفعونكم أو يضرون﴾: conjoined to يسمعونكم; ينفعونكم is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and يضرون is the same.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿قالوا بل وجدنا آباءنا كذلك يفعلون﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بل﴾ is for digression (iḍrāb); وجدنا is a verb and its fāʿil; آباءنا is the first object of ﴿وجدنا﴾, and the clause يفعلون is the second object; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "they do a doing like that", or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) fronted before ﴿يفعلون﴾; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām indicates distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿قال أفرأيتم ما كنتم تعبدون﴾: قال is a past verb; the hamza is interrogative, and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position. The clause تعبدون is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿أنتم وآباؤكم الأقدمون﴾: أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in ﴿تعبدون﴾; آباؤكم is conjoined to ﴿أنتم﴾; and الأقدمون is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آباؤكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿فإنهم عدو لي إلا رب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and عدو is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عدو﴾; إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿رب﴾ is accusative by exception, and the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ); and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿الذي خلقني﴾: الذي is accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب العالمين﴾, or a badal (substitute), or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); or nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the One who created me"; and it has been said: it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿هو يهدين﴾.
﴿فهو يهدين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يهدين is its khabar; the yāʾ has been dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿والذي هو يطعمني ويسقين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause يطعمني is the khabar (predicate), and يسقين is conjoined to يطعمني.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وإذا مرضت فهو يشفين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشفين﴾; مرضت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يشفين is its khabar (predicate); the yāʾ has been dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿والذي يميتني ثم يحيين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿الذي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يميتني﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. ﴿ثم يحيين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يميتني﴾.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿والذي أطمع أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذي is conjoined to what precedes it; the clause أطمع is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "for (في) His forgiving"; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفر﴾; خطيئتي is the object of يغفر; and يوم الدين is an adverb, also attached to ﴿يغفر﴾.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person yāʾ, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿هب﴾ is a verb of supplication (duʿāʾ) indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هب﴾; حكمًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ألحقني is a verb of supplication indeclinable on sukūn, conjoined to ﴿هب﴾, and the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿بالصالحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألحقني﴾.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿واجعل لي لسان صدق في الآخرين﴾: ﴿اجعل﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of ﴿اجعل﴾; لسان صدق is the first object of ﴿اجعل﴾; and ﴿في الآخرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿واجعلني من ورثة جنة النعيم﴾: اجعلني is a verb of supplication (duʿāʾ) indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من ورثة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of اجعلني; and جنة النعيم is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿واغفر لأبي إنه كان من الضالين﴾: ﴿لأبي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغفر﴾; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause كان is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من الضالين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of كان; and the clause ﴿إنه﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿ولا تخزني يوم يبعثون﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is of request (ṭalabiyya); ﴿تخزني﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the fāʿil (agent) is latent, and the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تخزني﴾; يبعثون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause يبعثون is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون﴾: يوم is an adverb in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from the first يوم; ﴿لا ينفع مال﴾: لا is negating, ﴿ينفع﴾ is an imperfect verb and مال is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا ينفع مال﴾ is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; and ﴿ولا بنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿مال﴾.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿إلا من أتى الله بقلب سليم﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from the omitted object, or as excepted from it, the implied form being "neither wealth nor sons will benefit anyone except one who comes"; it has also been said: it is the object of ﴿ينفع﴾; ﴿بقلب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أتى﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied [by]"; and ﴿سليم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قلب﴾.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿وأزلفت الجنة للمتقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿لا ينفع﴾; أزلفت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); الجنة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿للمتقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أزلفت﴾.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿وبرزت الجحيم للغاوين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿أزلفت الجنة﴾; ﴿برزت﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); الجحيم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿للغاوين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿برزت﴾.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وقيل لهم أين ما كنتم تعبدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قيل﴾; ﴿أين﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. The clause تعبدون is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿من دون الله هل ينصرونكم أو ينتصرون﴾: ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); هل is an interrogative particle; ﴿ينصرونكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and ينتصرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t: ﴿فكبكبوا فيها هم والغاوون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كبكبوا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كبكبوا﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw in ﴿كبكبوا﴾; and الغاوون is conjoined to the wāw in ﴿كبكبوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿وجنود إبليس أجمعون﴾: ﴿جنود﴾ is conjoined to the wāw in ﴿كبكبوا﴾; ﴿إبليس﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and أجمعون is a tawkīd (emphasis), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t: ﴿قالوا وهم فيها يختصمون﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يختصمون﴾; the clause يختصمون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the pronoun refers back to ﴿الغاوون﴾.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿تالله إن كنا لفي ضلال مبين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿تالله﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "نقسم", and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿قالوا﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy [إنّ] and inoperative (muhmala); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿إذ نسويكم برب العالمين﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كنّا في ضلال﴾ in the previous verse, or attached to an omitted verb, the implied form being "ضللنا إذ نسويكم"; ﴿نسويكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿نسويكم﴾ is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; and ﴿برب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نسويكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t: ﴿وما أضلنا إلا المجرمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; أضلنا is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and المجرمون is the fāʿil (agent) of أضلنا.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿فما لنا من شافعين﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); ما is negating; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) particle; and ﴿شافعين﴾ is genitive in form and nominative in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:101-101.t: ﴿ولا صديق حميم﴾: conjoined to شافعين, and حميم is a naʿt (adjective) of صديق.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t: ﴿فلو أن لنا كرة فنكون من المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لو is a particle of wishing (tamannī) or of condition, and the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, its implied form being "we would have done such-and-such"; ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "نتمنى", or the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb if ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿كرة﴾ is the postponed noun of أن; the clause ﴿فلو أن...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿فنكون﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and ﴿نكون﴾ is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "would that we had a return, and [so] our being among the believers"; the noun of نكون is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; and ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of نكون.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آية﴾ is its postponed noun; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن and الرحيم a second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾ and الرحيم a second khabar, and the clause ﴿هو العزيز الرحيم﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t: ﴿كذبت قوم نوح المرسلين﴾: كذبت is a past verb; قوم is the fāʿil (agent) and نوح is muḍāf ilayhi; and المرسلين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿إذ قال لهم أخوهم نوح ألا تتقون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; ﴿أخوهم﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿قال﴾, and نوح is a badal (substitute); ألا is a particle of proposal (ʿarḍ); and تتقون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t: ﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to رسول; ﴿رسول﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and أمين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:108-108.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t: ﴿وما أسألكم عليه من أجر إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أسألكم is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿أجر﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is a mafʿūl bihi; إن is negating; أجري is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿على رب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t: ﴿قالوا أنؤمن لك واتبعك الأرذلون﴾: قال is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿أنؤمن﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and نؤمن is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نؤمن﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (for ḥāl), with قد implied; ﴿اتبعك الأرذلون﴾: اتبع is a past verb, the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الأرذلون is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t: ﴿قال وما علمي بما كانوا يعملون﴾: قال is a past verb; the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and علمي is its khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿علمي﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is negating and the khabar is omitted; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position. The clause يعملون is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t: ﴿إن حسابهم إلا على ربي لو تشعرون﴾: إن is negating; حسابهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿على ربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿حسابهم﴾; لو is of non-occurrence (imtināʿiyya); تشعرون is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb; and the apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "you would not have found fault with them, nor attributed any deficiency to them".

muyesser-irab:114-114.t: ﴿وما أنا بطارد المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating ما that operates like ليس; ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بطارد﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿طارد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; and ﴿المؤمنين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t: ﴿إن أنا إلا نذير مبين﴾: إن is negating; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); نذير is the khabar (predicate), and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:116-116.t: ﴿قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح لتكونن من المرجومين﴾: قال is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تنته is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿لتكونن﴾: the lām is [that of] the answer to the oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted; تكونن is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the noun of تكونن is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; and ﴿من المرجومين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:117-117.t: ﴿قال رب إن قومي كذبون﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿رب﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the vocative particle is omitted; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, قومي is its noun, and the clause كذبون is its khabar (predicate); كذبون is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the first-person yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:118-118.t: ﴿فافتح بيني وبينهم فتحا ونجني ومن معي من المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); افتح is a verb of request, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿بيني﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿افتح﴾, and ﴿بينهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بيني﴾; فتحًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ونجني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and نجني is conjoined to ﴿افتح﴾; ﴿ومَن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and مَن is conjoined to the yāʾ in ﴿نجني﴾, or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); ﴿معي﴾ is an adverb attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:119-119.t: ﴿فأنجيناه ومن معه في الفلك المشحون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أنجيناه is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مَن is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined to the hāʾ in أنجيناه; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿في الفلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the [notion of] settledness (al-istiqrār) to which the adverb is attached; and المشحون is a naʿt (adjective) of الفلك.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿ثم أغرقنا بعد الباقين﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); أغرقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb of time indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning, the intended sense being "after rescuing them"; and الباقين is the object of أغرقنا.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the postponed noun of إن; the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن and الرحيم a second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾ and الرحيم a second khabar, and the clause ﴿هو العزيز الرحيم﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t: ﴿كذبت عاد المرسلين﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:124-124.t: ﴿إذ قال لهم أخوهم هود ألا تتقون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; أخوهم is the fāʿil (agent), and هود is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أخوهم﴾; ألا is a particle of proposal (ʿarḍ); تتقون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:125-125.t: ﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to رسول; رسول is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and أمين is a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وأطيعون: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t: ﴿وما أسألكم عليه من أجر إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أسألكم is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿أجر﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is a mafʿūl bihi; إن is negating; أجري is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿على رب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:128-128.t: ﴿أتبنون بكل ريع آية تعبثون﴾: the question is for reproach and rebuke; تبنون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بكل ريع﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبنون﴾; آية is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تعبثون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause تعبثون is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:129-129.t: ﴿وتتخذون مصانع لعلكم تخلدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and تتخذون is conjoined to تبنون; تتخذون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and مصانع is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لعلكم تخلدون﴾: لعل is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the kāf is its noun, and the clause تخلدون is its khabar (predicate); the clause of hope is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "hoping and expecting to be immortal in this world".

muyesser-irab:130-130.t: ﴿وإذا بطشتم بطشتم جبارين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, which is the second بطشتم; بطشتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the first clause بطشتم is in the position of the genitive through ﴿إذا﴾ being annexed to it; and جبارين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "heedless of results and consequences".

muyesser-irab:131-131.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وأطيعون: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t: ﴿واتقوا الذي أمدكم بما تعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذي is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أمدكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمدكم﴾; and the clause تعلمون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t: ﴿أمدكم بأنعام وبنين﴾: أمدكم: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿بأنعام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمدكم﴾. بنين: conjoined to ﴿أنعام﴾. The clause ﴿أمدكم بأنعام﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) of the preceding clause ﴿أمدكم بما تعلمون﴾ and has no grammatical position; or it is a badal (substitute) from the clause ﴿أمدكم بما تعلمون﴾, with the governor repeated.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t: ﴿إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أخاف is its khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخاف﴾; عذاب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), يوم is muḍāf ilayhi, and عظيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:136-136.t: ﴿قالوا سواء علينا أوعظت أم لم تكن من الواعظين﴾: سواء is a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سواء﴾; the hamza is interrogative; ﴿وعظت﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); أم is a conjunction; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; ﴿تكن﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿من الواعظين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and the hamza of equivalence (taswiya) together with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "your admonishing is all the same to us".

muyesser-irab:137-137.t: ﴿إن هذا إلا خلق الأولين﴾: إن is negating; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); خلق is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هذا﴾, and الأولين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:138-138.t: ﴿وما نحن بمعذبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating ما that operates like ليس; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بمعذبين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿معذبين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿فكذبوه فأهلكناهم﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); كذبوه is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأهلكناهم is conjoined to ﴿فكذبوه﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and آية is the noun of إن.
﴿وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, رب is the noun of إن and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); العزيز is the first khabar (predicate) of إن and الرحيم the second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾ and الرحيم a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:141-141.t: ﴿كذبت ثمود المرسلين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; كذبت is a past verb, ثمود is the fāʿil (agent), and المرسلين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:142-142.t: ﴿إذ قال لهم أخوهم صالح ألا تتقون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; ﴿أخوهم﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and صالح is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أخوهم﴾; ألا is a particle of proposal (ʿarḍ); تتقون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:143-143.t: ﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to رسول; رسول is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and أمين is a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:144-144.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t: ﴿وما أسألكم عليه من أجر إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; ﴿أسألكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿أجر﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is a mafʿūl bihi; إن is negating; أجري is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿على رب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:146-146.t: ﴿أتتركون في ما ههنا آمنين﴾: the hamza is interrogative; تتركون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿فيما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتركون﴾; ﴿ها﴾ is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh), and هنا is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position. آمنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in تتركون.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t: ﴿في جنات وعيون﴾: ﴿في جنات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is a badal (substitute) from His words ﴿فيما هاهنا﴾, with the preposition repeated; and عيون is conjoined to جنات.

muyesser-irab:148-148.t: ﴿وزروع ونخل طلعها هضيم﴾: ﴿زروع ونخل﴾ is conjoined to جنات; طلعها is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and هضيم is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of نخل.

muyesser-irab:149-149.t: ﴿وتنحتون من الجبال بيوتا فارهين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تنحتون is conjoined to تتركون, so it falls within the scope of the question of disapproval and rebuke, and the position of the rebuking interrogative clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من الجبال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنحتون﴾; بيوتًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and فارهين is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أطيعون is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ — dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:151-151.t: ﴿ولا تطيعوا أمر المسرفين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تطيعوا is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and أمر المسرفين is an object.

muyesser-irab:152-152.t: ﴿الذين يفسدون في الأرض ولا يصلحون﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of المسرفين; the clause يفسدون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفسدون﴾; and ولا يصلحون is conjoined to His word يفسدون.

muyesser-irab:153-153.t: ﴿قالوا إنما أنت من المسحرين﴾: إنما is [إنّ as] restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من المسحرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:154-154.t: ﴿ما أنت إلا بشر مثلنا فأت بآية إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: ما is negating; أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar (predicate), and مثلنا is a naʿt (adjective); ﴿فائت﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "if you are truthful as you claim, then bring"; ﴿بآية﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word فائت; إن is conditional; ﴿كنت﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and the tāʾ is its noun, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of كان; and the apodosis of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then bring a sign".

muyesser-irab:155-155.t: ﴿قال هذه ناقة لها شرب ولكم شرب يوم معلوم﴾: هذه is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ناقة is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar, and شرب is the postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ناقة; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, and شرب يوم is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and معلوم is a naʿt of يوم.

muyesser-irab:156-156.t: ﴿ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسوها is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بسوء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمسوها﴾; ﴿فيأخذكم﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and يأخذكم is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no touching, and [so] a seizing"; عذاب is the fāʿil, يوم is muḍāf ilayhi, and عظيم is a naʿt (adjective) of يوم.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t: ﴿فعقروها فأصبحوا نادمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; عقروها is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فأصبحوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أصبحوا نادمين﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun and نادمين is its khabar (predicate); or ﴿أصبحوا﴾ is complete (tāmma), the wāw is the fāʿil, and نادمين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿فأخذهم العذاب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخذهم is a past verb, the hāʾ is a fronted object, and العذاب is the postponed fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن في ذلك لآية﴾: giving the reason for the seizing; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿آية﴾ is the postponed noun of إن.
﴿وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar.

zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Shuʿarāʾ
Meccan
﷽
His saying, the Exalted: ﴿طسم﴾ — it was read with the nūn assimilated (idghām) into the mīm and the letters joined to one another; and it was read "طَسِينْ مِيمْ", pronouncing the nūn distinctly and pausing on the nūn. It is also permissible — though I know of no one who read it so — to say "طَسِمِيمًا", making "طسم" a name for the sura, in the manner of his saying "خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ" (fifteen); but reciting it so is not permitted.

zajjaj:2-2.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿تِلْكَ آياتُ الكِتابِ المُبِينِ﴾ — there are two ways (wajhān) in it. One of them is on the meaning that they had been promised the Quran on the tongue of Moses, so the meaning would be: "these are the verses of the Book which you were promised on the tongue of Moses"; and (the other is) on the meaning: "these are the verses of the clear Book". We have explained that at the beginning of Sūrat "al-Baqara", in His saying: ﴿الم﴾ [al-Baqara: 1] ﴿ذَلِكَ الكِتابُ﴾ [al-Baqara: 2].

zajjaj:3-3.t: His saying: ﴿لَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ ألا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ — Abū ʿUbayda said: its meaning is "destroying yourself"; and it was said: "killing yourself". This is like His saying: ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ عَلى آثارِهِمْ إنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَذا الحَدِيثِ أسَفًا﴾ [al-Kahf: 6]. The position of "أنْ" is accusative, as a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose); the meaning is: "perhaps you are killing yourself because of their abandoning faith". So Allah, Glorified is He, informed him that had He wished to send down what would compel them to obedience, He would have been able to do so; but He, Mighty and Majestic, has laid upon them worship by which, together with faith, they merit reward, and He sent down for them signs by which the truth becomes clear to whoever seeks it. As for if punishment were sent down upon everyone who turns obstinately from the truth at the time of his obstinacy, he would submit under compulsion and believe with the faith of one who finds no way of escape from faith.

zajjaj:4-4.t:
His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَظَلَّتْ أعْناقُهم لَها خاضِعِينَ﴾ — its meaning is "then their necks would remain (fa-taẓallu)", because in the apodosis (jazāʾ) the past-tense form occurs with a future meaning. You say "إنْ تَأْتِنِي أكْرَمْتُكَ", meaning "أُكْرِمْكَ" (I will honour you); and "إنْ أتَيْتَنِي وأحْسَنْتَ", meaning "and you do good and act well". He said "خاضِعِينَ" while mentioning the necks, because the meaning of the submission of the necks is the submission of the owners of the necks; since submission is only by the submitting of the necks, it is permissible to make the statement about the muḍāf ilayhi, as the poet said:
رَأتْ مَرَّ السِّنِينَ أخَذْنَ مِنِّي ∗∗∗ كَما أخَذَ السِّرارُ مِنَ الهِلالِ
(She saw the passing of the years — they took from me as the dark of the month takes from the crescent.)
Since years exist only by passing, he made the statement about the years, even though he had annexed the passing to them. Similar to that also is the saying of the poet:
مَشَيْنَ كَما اهْتَزَّتْ رِماحٌ تَسَفَّهَتْ ∗∗∗ أعالِيَها مَرُّ الرِّياحِ النَّواسِمِ
(They walked swaying as lances sway whose tips the passing of the gentle breezes has set tossing.)
as though he said "the winds set them tossing" (tasaffahathā, feminine), since winds exist only by passing. It came in the exegesis that by "أعْناقُهم" their great ones and their chiefs are meant; and it came in the language that "أعْناقُهم" means their groups: one says "جاءَ لِي عُنُقٌ مِنَ النّاسِ", that is: a group. Some of them mentioned another way; they said: "فَظَلَّتْ أعْناقُهم لَها خاضِعِينَ هم", with "هم" implied, and recited:
تَرى أرْباقَهم مُتَقَلِّدِيها كَما ∗∗∗ صَدِئَ الحَدِيدُ عَنِ الكُماةِ
(You see their halters — wearing them round their necks — as iron grows rusty on armoured warriors.)
This is not permissible in the Quran. It is, on the basis of the badal of error (badal al-ghalaṭ), permissible in poetry, as though he said: "he sees their halters, he sees those wearing them", as though he said: "he sees a people wearing their halters". Had it been on the omission of "هم", it would also have been among what is permissible in poetry.

zajjaj:6-6.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أنْباءُ ما كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾: "أنْباءُ" means reports. The meaning is: "they will come to know the news of that at the Resurrection"; and it is possible that some of that is hastened for them in this world, such as what befell them on the Day of "Badr".

zajjaj:7-7.t: His saying: ﴿أوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إلى الأرْضِ كَمْ أنْبَتْنا فِيها مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ﴾: the meaning of "زَوْجٍ" is: kind; and the meaning of "كَرِيمٍ" is: praiseworthy in what is needed, with the meaning of "of every beneficial kind", the causing of which to grow and the bringing of which into being none is able to do except the Lord of the worlds.

zajjaj:8-8.t:
Then He said: ﴿إنَّ في ذَلِكَ لآيَةً﴾: an indication that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is One, and that created things are signs pointing to the Creator being One; there is nothing like Him.
His saying: ﴿وَما كانَ أكْثَرُهم مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ means: most of them were not going to believe, that is: Allah knew that most of them would never believe, as He said: ﴿وَلا أنْتُمْ عابِدُونَ ما أعْبُدُ﴾ [al-Kāfirūn: 3], that is: you are not worshipping what I worship now; ﴿وَلا أنْتُمْ عابِدُونَ ما أعْبُدُ﴾ [al-Kāfirūn: 5], in what is to come; and like His saying in the story of Noah, peace be upon him: ﴿أنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إلا مَن قَدْ آمَنَ﴾ [Hūd: 36], so He informed him that most of them would not believe.

zajjaj:10-10.t: His saying: ﴿وَإذْ نادى رَبُّكَ مُوسى أنِ ائْتِ القَوْمَ الظّالِمِينَ﴾: the position of "إذْ" is accusative, on the meaning: "and recite this story among what you recite". The proof of that is His saying, conjoined to this story: ﴿واتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأ إبْراهِيمَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 69].

zajjaj:13-13.t: His saying: ﴿وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي ولا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسانِي﴾ — with the accusative and the nominative. Whoever reads the nominative conjoins it to "أخافَ", on the meaning: "I fear, and my breast is constricted"; and whoever reads the accusative conjoins it to "أنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ وأنْ يَضِيقَ صَدْرِي وألّا يَنْطَلِقَ لِسانِي". The nominative is more common in recitation. And His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَأرْسِلْ إلى هارُونَ﴾, that is: "so that he may help me and support me in my affair"; this was omitted because there is an indication of it in the speech.

zajjaj:14-14.t: His saying, the Exalted: ﴿وَلَهم عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأخافُ أنْ يَقْتُلُونِ﴾: by the "sin" he means the man whom he struck with his fist and killed: I fear that they will kill me for my killing him.

zajjaj:15-15.t: ﴿قالَ كَلا فاذْهَبا بِآياتِنا﴾: "كَلّا" is a deterrent and a rebuke against persisting in this supposition, as though He said: desist from this supposition and trust in Allah.

zajjaj:16-16.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿فَقُولا إنّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ العالَمِينَ﴾ means: "we are the message of the Lord of the worlds", that is: "bearers of the message of the Lord of the worlds". The poet said:
لَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الواشُونَ ما بُحْتُ عِنْدَهم ∗∗∗ بِسِرٍّ ولا أرْسَلْتُهم بِرَسُولِ
(The slanderers have lied: I disclosed no secret to them, nor did I send them with any message.)

zajjaj:17-17.t: His saying, Glorified is He: ﴿أنْ أرْسِلْ مَعَنا بَنِي إسْرائِيلَ﴾: the position of "أنْ" is accusative; the meaning is: "we have been sent so that you send", that is: "so that you send the Children of Israel with us".

zajjaj:18-18.t: ﴿قالَ ألَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينا ولِيدًا﴾, that is: as a newborn, when you were born. ﴿وَلَبِثْتَ فِينا مِن عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ﴾ — "مِن عُمْرِكَ" with the mīm quiescent is permissible, and "مِن عَمْرِكَ" with fatḥa on the ʿayn is permissible. One says "العُمْرُ", "اَلْعُمُرُ" and "اَلْعَمْرُ" for a person's lifetime; but in an oath nothing is permissible except "لَعَمْرُ اللَّهِ", nothing else, with fatḥa on the ʿayn. Sībawayh, al-Khalīl and all the Basrans mentioned that (the word in) the oath has fatḥa and nothing else. So Pharaoh reckoned it against Moses that he had raised him as a child from the time he was born until he grew up.

zajjaj:19-19.t: ﴿وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ﴾ — al-Shaʿbī read "فِعْلَتَكَ" with kasra on the fāʾ; the fatḥa is better and more common, because he means: "you killed the person, your (single) killing", on the pattern of the single instance. Al-Shaʿbī read it with the meaning: "and you killed in the manner of killing that you know", because he killed him with a single blow of the fist. One says "جَلَسْتُ جَلْسَةً" meaning "one time", and "جَلَسْتُ جِلْسَةً" with kasra meaning the manner of sitting. ﴿وَأنْتَ مِنَ الكافِرِينَ﴾ — there are two ways in it. One of them: "of those ungrateful for my favour"; the other: "and you are of the disbelievers by your killing the one you killed". So Moses ﷺ denied disbelief and admitted that this deed of his had been ignorance, and said: ﴿قالَ فَعَلْتُها إذًا وأنا مِنَ الضّالِّينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 20], that is: of the ignorant. It has been read: "وَأنا مِنَ الجاهِلِينَ".

zajjaj:21-21.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا﴾: the Torah is meant, in which is the judgement of Allah.

zajjaj:22-22.t:
His saying, the Exalted: ﴿وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّها عَلَيَّ أنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إسْرائِيلَ﴾ — the exegetes took it as a denial that this could be a favour, as though he said: "so what favour do you have over me in your having enslaved the Children of Israel?!". The wording is the wording of a statement (khabar), and the meaning can be taken as they said, given that its wording is that of a statement; and in it there is a rebuke to the one addressed, as though he said to him: "this is a favour — that you took the Children of Israel as slaves!", by way of rebuking Pharaoh. The wording requires that Moses ﷺ said: "this is a favour because you took the Children of Israel as slaves and did not take me as a slave". One says "عَبَّدْتُ الرَّجُلَ" and "أعْبَدْتُهُ": I took him as a slave. The position of "أنْ" is nominative as a badal (substitute) for "نِعْمَةٌ", as though he said: "and that is a favour: your enslaving the Children of Israel and your leaving me not a slave". It is also possible for "أنْ" to be in the position of the accusative, the meaning being: "it only became a favour to me because you enslaved the Children of Israel", that is: "had you not done what you did, my family would have looked after me and would not have cast me into the river; so it only became a favour through the affliction you inflicted". The poet said, on "أعْبَدْتُ" meaning "I took as a slave":
عَلامَ يُعْبِدُنِي قَوْمِي وقَدْ كَثُرَتْ ∗∗∗ فِيهِمْ أباعِرُ ما شاؤُوا وعِبْدانُ؟
(Why do my people take me as a slave, when among them camels and slaves have multiplied, as many as they please?)

zajjaj:23-23.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وما رَبُّ العالَمِينَ﴾ — Moses ﷺ answered him with that which is an indication of Allah, Majestic and Mighty, through what He created, the like of which created beings are unable to produce. He said: ﴿رَبُّ السَّماواتِ والأرْضِ وما بَيْنَهُما إنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 24]. Pharaoh was perplexed and gave no answer back by which to refute this statement, so he said to those around him: ﴿ألا تَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 25]. Moses increased him in clarity and said: ﴿رَبُّكم ورَبُّ آبائِكُمُ الأوَّلِينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 26]. He did not answer him this time either, but said: ﴿إنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إلَيْكم لَمَجْنُونٌ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 27]. Then Moses said, in further clarification: ﴿قالَ رَبُّ المَشْرِقِ والمَغْرِبِ وما بَيْنَهُما إنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 28]. In none of these things did he answer him with a refutation of his argument.

zajjaj:29-29.t:
﴿قالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إلَهًا غَيْرِي لأجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ المَسْجُونِينَ﴾ — so he increased him in clarity and argued with what he and the assembly around him witnessed: ﴿قالَ أوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 30] ﴿قالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّادِقِينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 31] ﴿فَألْقى عَصاهُ فَإذا هي ثُعْبانٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 32]. The thuʿbān is the large kind of snake.
If someone says: how then does it come: ﴿فَإذا هي ثُعْبانٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 32], while in another place: ﴿تَهْتَزُّ كَأنَّها جانٌّ﴾ [al-Naml: 10], and the jānn is the small kind of snake? The answer: this is among what indicates the greatness of the sign; that is, its form was the form of the thuʿbān, while its quivering, its motion and its nimbleness were like the quivering and nimbleness of the jānn.

zajjaj:33-33.t: ﴿وَنَـزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإذا هي بَيْضاءُ لِلنّاظِرِينَ﴾: he drew his hand from the opening of his garment and brought it out white with a luminous whiteness, without harm (sūʾ), that is: without leprosy. He (Pharaoh) had no way of repelling what he witnessed except to say: this is sorcery: ﴿قالَ لِلْمَلإ حَوْلَهُ إنَّ هَذا لَساحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 34]; so he made the miraculous sign sorcery.

zajjaj:35-35.t: Then he humbled himself and submitted to those who were among his followers, and said: ﴿يُرِيدُ أنْ يُخْرِجَكم مِن أرْضِكم بِسِحْرِهِ فَماذا تَأْمُرُونَ﴾ ﴿قالُوا أرْجِهْ وأخاهُ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 36] — with kasra on the hāʾ and with ḍamma, and with the yāʾ and the wāw: "أرْجِهِي" and "أرْجِهُو وأخاهُ". ﴿وابْعَثْ في المَدائِنِ حاشِرِينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 36]. The meaning of "أرْجِهْ" is: postpone him; and it came in the exegesis: detain him and his brother; the meaning is one. Its interpretation is: postpone him from this present time of yours, and postpone completing the debate with him until the sorcerers are gathered for you.

zajjaj:38-38.t: His saying: ﴿فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ﴾ — this made it unnecessary to say: "so he sent and gathered the sorcerers".

zajjaj:42-42.t: His saying: ﴿قالَ نَعَمْ وإنَّكم إذًا لَمِنَ المُقَرَّبِينَ﴾, that is: you will have, along with your wage and your reward for overcoming Moses if you overcome him, in addition to that benefit, nearness and closeness with me. It is read "أئِنَّ لَنا لَأجْرًا" as a question; and "إنَّ لَنا لَأجْرًا" is permissible, not as a question but out of their confidence in him: they said "we shall surely have a reward", that is: you are one who gives us gifts and rewards us.

zajjaj:44-44.t: ﴿فَألْقَوْا حِبالَهم وعِصِيَّهم وقالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إنّا لَنَحْنُ الغالِبُونَ﴾ ﴿فَألْقى مُوسى عَصاهُ فَإذا هي تَلْقَفُ ما يَأْفِكُونَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 45], that is: of what they had gathered of their stratagem and their staffs. It is related of them that they were twelve thousand sorcerers. So Moses, peace be upon him, was given victory at a time when sorcery was at its greatest and most dominant over the people of that age; and his sign was a dazzling sign in two respects: one of them, that he brought what created beings are incapable of; and the second, that the sorcerers, numbering this many, were thrown down in prostration.

zajjaj:47-47.t:
﴿قالُوا آمَنّا بِرَبِّ العالَمِينَ﴾ — so they surrendered the matter to Allah, and what cannot be repelled became clear to them. Likewise the Prophet ﷺ was sent when the Arabs were at their most poetic, their most eloquent in oratory and their most articulate; and he called them to faith in Allah with the signs which the Prophet ﷺ brought and with the Quran, by which he challenged them to produce a sura like it, and they were unable to produce a sura like it. It is also related that the sorcerers were nineteen thousand.
His saying: ﴿فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 49]: the lām has entered upon "سَوْفَ" with the meaning of tawkīd (emphasis). The Kufans did not permit "إنَّ زَيْدًا لَسَوْفَ يَقُومُ", yet the entry of the lām upon سَوْفَ has occurred, and that is because the lām is emphatic.

zajjaj:49-49.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿لأُقَطِّعَنَّ أيْدِيَكم وأرْجُلَكم مِن خِلافٍ﴾ — it is related in the exegesis that the first to cut off (hands and feet) and to crucify was Pharaoh.

zajjaj:50-50.t: ﴿قالُوا لا ضَيْرَ إنّا إلى رَبِّنا مُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾, that is: there is no harm to us in what befalls us in this world, along with our hope of forgiveness.

zajjaj:51-51.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿إنّا نَطْمَعُ أنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنا رَبُّنا خَطايانا أنْ كُنّا أوَّلَ المُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ — with fatḥa on "أنْ", that is: because we were the first of the believers. Al-Farrāʾ claimed that they were the first believers among the people of their age; but I do not think he knew the report in the exegesis, because it came in the exegesis that those who were with Moses, peace be upon him, were six hundred thousand, and it was said: six hundred and seventy thousand. Rather, the meaning of ﴿أنْ كُنّا أوَّلَ المُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ is: the first to believe in this situation, upon the appearance of Moses's sign, when they had thrown down their ropes and their staffs and had exerted themselves in their sorcery. One says "لا ضَيْرَ" and "لا ضَوْرَ" with the meaning of "لا ضُرَّ" and "لا ضَرَرَ" (no harm).

zajjaj:52-52.t: His saying: ﴿وَأوْحَيْنا إلى مُوسى أنْ أسْرِ بِعِبادِي﴾: one says "أسْرى، يُسْرِي" when one travels by night; and "سَرى يَسْرِي" — it was said that it too has the meaning of "أسْرى، يُسْرِي".

zajjaj:53-53.t:
His saying: ﴿فَأرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ في المَدائِنِ حاشِرِينَ﴾, that is: he sent those who would gather the army for him; its meaning is: "so he gathered his host". Then he said: ﴿إنَّ هَؤُلاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 54]. "اَلشِّرْذِمَةُ" in the speech of the Arabs is: a small number. It is related that those whom he called a "شِرْذِمَة" were six hundred and seventy thousand, while Pharaoh's vanguard was seven hundred thousand, every man of them on a stallion with a helmet on his head; so he reckoned those with Moses, peace be upon him, as few in view of the great size of his own host. He said "قَلِيلُونَ", putting "قَلِيلًا" in the plural, just as one says "هَؤُلاءِ واحِدُونَ", putting واحِد in the plural, as al-Kumayt said:
فَقَدْ رَجَعُوا كَحَيٍّ واحِدِينا
(So they returned like a single tribe, as ones.)

zajjaj:55-55.t: His saying: ﴿وَإنَّهم لَنا لَغائِظُونَ﴾: one says "قَدْ غاظَنِي فُلانٌ" (so-and-so has enraged me); whoever says "أغاظَنِي" has committed a solecism (laḥn).

zajjaj:56-56.t: His saying: ﴿وَإنّا لَجَمِيعٌ حاذِرُونَ﴾ — it is also read "حَذِرُونَ". It came in the exegesis that the meaning of "حاذِرُونَ" is muʾdūn, that is: possessing equipment (adāt), that is: possessing weapons, and weapons are the equipment of war. So "اَلْحاذِرُ" is the one prepared, and "اَلْحَذِرُ" is the one alert.

zajjaj:60-60.t: His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَأتْبَعُوهم مُشْرِقِينَ﴾, that is: at the time of sunrise. One says "أشْرَقْنا", that is: we entered upon the time of the rising of the sun. One says "شَرِقَتِ الشَّمْسُ" when it rises, and "أشْرَقَتْ" when it shines and becomes clear; and "أشْرَقْنا نَحْنُ": we entered upon sunrise.

zajjaj:61-61.t: His saying: ﴿فَلَمّا تَراءى الجَمْعانِ﴾, that is: when the host of Moses stood facing the host of Pharaoh — the companions of Moses had gone out by night — the companions of Moses said: ﴿إنّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ﴾, that is: the host of Pharaoh, this great multitude, will overtake us, and we have no strength against them.

zajjaj:62-62.t: ﴿قالَ كَلا إنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ﴾, that is: Moses said "كَلّا", that is: desist and be restrained, for they will not overtake us.

zajjaj:63-63.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿فَأوْحَيْنا إلى مُوسى أنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصاكَ البَحْرَ فانْفَلَقَ فَكانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ﴾, that is: every part that separated from it, ﴿كالطَّوْدِ العَظِيمِ﴾, that is: like the great mountain.

zajjaj:64-64.t: His saying: ﴿وَأزْلَفْنا ثَمَّ الآخَرِينَ﴾, that is: We brought the others near to drowning there, and they are the companions of Pharaoh. Abū ʿUbayda said: (it means) We gathered the others there; he said: and from that "مُزْدَلِفَةُ" was called "جَمْعًا" (Jamʿ). Both statements are good and fine, because gathering them is bringing them near to one another. The origin of "اَلزُّلْفى" in the speech of the Arabs is: nearness.

zajjaj:69-69.t: His saying, the Exalted: ﴿واتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأ إبْراهِيمَ﴾ means: the report of Abraham.

zajjaj:71-71.t: His saying: ﴿فَنَظَلُّ لَها عاكِفِينَ﴾ means: persisting in worshipping them.

zajjaj:72-72.t: His saying: ﴿هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكم إذْ تَدْعُونَ﴾ — if you wish, you pronounce the dhāl distinctly, and if you wish, you assimilate it into the tāʾ, making it a tāʾ, and say "إتَّدْعُونَ"; this is better in Arabic because of the closeness of the dhāl to the tāʾ. "إذَّدْعُونَ" is also permissible, but it was not read so, just as he said "مُدَّكِرْ", whose origin is "مُذْتَكِرْ".

zajjaj:77-77.t: His saying: ﴿فَإنَّهم عَدُوٌّ لِي إلا رَبَّ العالَمِينَ﴾ — the grammarians said: it is an exception not from (the kind of) the first, that is: "but the Lord of the worlds". It is also possible that they worshipped idols and other things along with Allah, so he said to them: everything you worship is an enemy to me except the Lord of the worlds, because they had made their gods equal to Allah; so he informed them that he had dissociated himself from what they worshipped except Allah, for he did not dissociate himself from worshipping Him.

zajjaj:82-82.t:
His saying: ﴿والَّذِي أطْمَعُ أنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ﴾ — it came in the exegesis that his sin was his saying: "Sarah is my sister".
And his saying: ﴿بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهم هَذا فاسْألُوهُمْ﴾ [al-Anbiyāʾ: 63], and his saying: ﴿فَقالَ إنِّي سَقِيمٌ﴾ [al-Ṣāffāt: 89]. We have explained the meaning of his saying: ﴿بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهم هَذا﴾ [al-Anbiyāʾ: 63]. The meaning of "خَطِيئَتِي" is that the prophets are human beings, and error may befall them; except that they — the blessings of Allah be upon them — do not commit major sins, because they are protected (maʿṣūmūn), chosen over the worlds; every prophet is superior to all the people of his age.

zajjaj:84-84.t: His saying: ﴿واجْعَلْ لِي لِسانَ صِدْقٍ في الآخِرِينَ﴾ means: grant me good praise that remains until the end of time.
